run_f_gold: run f_gold to check if array items can be distributed so no person gets two of the same type
test_f_gold: test f_gold against multiple parameter sets to verify correct distribution logic for given array n and k
review_f_gold: review f_gold which counts element occurrences and returns False if any element exceeds 2*k times
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold that validates whether items in an array can be fairly distributed among k people
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a hash map instead of nested loops for better performance on large arrays
